notes.title: Vive Video 1.2.2 Released
notes.notes: Vive Video has been updated to include SAVE EVERY BREATH: THE DUNKIRK VR EXPERIENCE.  Immerse yourself in the heart-pounding action of Christopher Nolan’s Dunkirk in anticipation of the film’s July 21st release.

notes.title: Vive Video 1.2 Released
notes.notes:
In this update:

- Improved the readability and consistency of several user interface elements
- Fixed an issue with occasional green flashes occurring at the beginning of video playback
- Fixed an issue with where gaze input was competing with controller input
- Fixed an issue causing playback to lock when seeking from the end of the video
- Fixed an issue when opening read-only video files
- Improved thumbnail loading speed
- Enlarged the minimum size of the  player UI
- Added a loading indicator to the video player UI
- Background music is no longer played when video playback is paused
